about.title: About Rare Character Compendium
about.what: Rare Character Compendium is a Glyph Atlas evidence wiki documenting Unicode-unencoded characters and unifiable variants for prospective IRG submissions. Anyone can add a character without an account, and changes are recorded in its history.
about.how: A picture or a link and a note of where you found it are enough. Anyone can later add its parts, sources, reading, or the code point it turns out to have. A character that proves to be encoded, a variant or a misprint stays on record, marked as such.
about.irgTitle: From a record to a proposal
about.irg: Records here are not submissions, and a status here is contributors' opinion. Proposals go to IRG through its members, or to the UTC, and both judge the evidence by their own rules. Each record shows how it compares with what IRG asks.
about.irgRule1: Printed evidence must be in regular script (楷書), and characters must appear in running text. Logos and separated images do not count.
about.irgRule2: Each evidence image needs a complete reference: author, title, publisher, year and page. A whole page is better than a clipping, with a red square that does not touch the character.
about.irgRule3: A character from a modern edition of an older text also needs an image of an original edition. Woodblock evidence should come from two sources where possible.
about.irgRule4: Evidence files must be PNG, JPEG, PDF or WebP under 1 MB, and preferably under 400 KB.
about.data: Every record can be read as JSON or CSV. Records and descriptions are under CC BY-SA 4.0. Images stay under the rights of their sources and are shown here as evidence.
about.apiCsv: All records as CSV, one row per sighting
about.privacy: A cookie keeps your browser's name, and your name appears on what you save. The site keeps a keyed hash of your address with each save, for moderators, and never shows it. Location and device data are removed from uploaded pictures.
about.takedown: Use Report on a record, or write to the contact address, if something misstates its source or should not be here. Material under review is hidden while it is checked.
about.source.pnp: IRG Principles & Procedures, Version 18 (IRG N2850R, 17 April 2026), Ken Lunde, IRG Convenor. The evidence checks and the rules above.
about.source.uax45: Unicode Standard Annex #45, U-Source Ideographs. The UTC's record of proposed ideographs.
about.source.glyphwiki: GlyphWiki (Koichi Kamichi). The model of an open wiki with anonymous editing, for a different goal: shared glyph outlines.
about.source.babelstone: BabelStone IDS (Andrew West, file date 27 June 2025), through ids-input. The check of a description against encoded characters. It compares exact text, so a match is only a hint.
about.source.ids: IDS Workshop and ids-input (mkpoli). The IDS editor on this site.
